Path: none

## Triage: first touch → `domain:server` · `lease:A5` · p2 · 2026-11-15T13:45Z

⛔ Not a claim.

With a messaging HTTP outbox configured, a durable http node with `method: 'GET'` never delivers. `sendOnce` sends a `'{}'` body, fetch refuses a GET with a body, and the outbox retries until the delivery dies. The documented fallback shape (#33487) fails silently wherever an outbox exists, so **p2**. A5 is the durable http node area, a sibling of #33655.

Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default (no path-derived mandate)`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Responsibility: `objectstack service-messaging: a durable http node with method GET or HEAD never delivers through the HTTP outbox (fetch refuses a GET with a body) | the no-outbox inline sender, which sends no body for GET | any deployment with the messaging HTTP outbox and a GET/HEAD http node`
Thread-read: 6895243444
Premise: holds
Route: the card's first expected option. A GET or HEAD outbox delivery carries no body and signs what it sends, as the inline sender (`sendInline`, `service-automation/src/builtin/http-nodes.ts`) already does. The save-time refusal option is not taken: it would narrow, and the 18.5.0 #33487 note names `method: 'GET'` as the supported shape.
Pre-claim lane: server because `packages/services/service-messaging/src/http-sender.ts`
Pre-claim deps: none. PR #33886 (S6, armed) edits `service-automation/src/builtin/http-nodes.ts` and `http-node-signing.test.ts`, not service-messaging; the dev runs `git merge-tree` against it and origin/main before push.
Prior rulings read: docs/adr/** grep outbox × GET/body/http → ADR-0012, ADR-0013, ADR-0018 (outbox-backed `http` executor; none rules on bodyless methods); #33487 / 18.5.0 CHANGELOG note (`method: 'GET'` keeps the old behaviour); #33655 / PR #33886 Acceptance note 2 and its inline GET pin. No ⛔ line conflicts; no test pins the opposite.
